baseline: Original hybrid ranking: top K from the hybrid-derived test candidate pool, before reranking
evaluation: Held-out test only; validation-selected strengths are reused without group-specific retuning
item_group_metrics: Discounted exposure share, group-specific recall (hits/relevant test items), precision (hits/recommendations), and hit rate (fraction of test users with a hit in the group). Exposure is distribution, not recommendation quality.

item_groups.definition: Head = top ceil(20%) of catalog by training interaction count; tail = remaining items

uncertainty.interpretation: Intervals describe uncertainty in the observed test-user sample; no significance claim is made.
uncertainty.method: paired user bootstrap percentile confidence interval

user_group_metrics: Macro per-user Precision, Recall, NDCG, MRR, Hit plus the objective targeted by that reranker; item fairness also reports group-level head/tail exposure gap.

user_groups.definition: Low = training interactions <= median over nonpadding users; high = > median
